title: Migration 1043 T016 Runtime Readiness path repair

phases.objective: Restore deterministic repository-relative resolution for the T016 Runtime Readiness dry-run and capability-envelope-create aliases, preserve immutable authorization-bound evidence publishing, and fail closed without granting Apply or runtime execution authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed Migration 1043 readiness workflow and read-only evidence publisher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact-head repository validation of the repaired T016 Runtime Readiness path
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Both capability-resolution aliases resolve from adminCliRoutes.js through import.meta.url without a doubled http-generic-api path, the backfill discovers the immutable authorization-bound non-skipped run with bounded pagination, and absent legacy booleans remain unverified rather than being misreported as false.
steps: Resolve capability_resolution_dry_run from adminCliRoutes.js using a file URL anchored to import.meta.url.
Resolve capability_resolution_envelope_create from adminCliRoutes.js using a file URL anchored to import.meta.url.
Reject any doubled http-generic-api/http-generic-api script path through focused alias regression coverage.
Accept only the approved immutable T016 authorization comment identifiers and paginate issue-comment runs until the authorization time boundary is reached.
Ignore skipped workflow runs when selecting the first eligible Runtime Readiness evidence run.
Publish only allowlisted bounded evidence fields and preserve absent legacy failure booleans and secrets_included as unverified.
Execute the focused alias-path and Runtime Readiness contract tests on the exact candidate head.
assertions: The dry-run and envelope-create built-in shell aliases use repository-relative absolute script paths derived from import.meta.url.
Neither alias can resolve to a doubled http-generic-api/http-generic-api path.
The read-only backfill remains bound to an approved immutable authorization comment and reaches its authorization boundary with bounded pagination.
Skipped runs are never selected as Runtime Readiness evidence.
Unknown legacy failure booleans and secrets_included are represented as unverified rather than coerced to false.

The repair does not invoke Runtime Readiness, create or approve a capability envelope, authorize or send Apply, execute Migration 1043, synchronize the activation registry, mutate a database, call a provider, deploy, restart, mutate Production or a protected ref, access credential payloads, or perform an external business write.

phases.objective: Publish exact run-bound Runtime Readiness evidence only after a new explicit operator authorization following merge.
Keep path drift, authorization ambiguity, pagination exhaustion, skipped-run selection, missing Artifacts, and unknown legacy evidence fail-closed.
Complete Draft and Ready exact-head validation before any merge or separately authorized Runtime Readiness cycle.

This repair grants no Runtime Readiness invocation, Migration Apply, activation-registry synchronization, deployment, provider call, external business write, database mutation, or Production ref mutation authority.
